# Contact us
**Having trouble accessing data?** Check the status of our servers: http://status.openspaceproject.com/

**Need some help to get started?** View tutorials and OpenSpace documentation

**Have questions not answered on our website or Wiki?**
  - **Join our Slack**: openspacesupport.slack.com
  - **Join our Reddit**: https://www.reddit.com/r/OpenSpaceProject/

**Having an issue?** Check for known issues or submit new ones on our GitHub: https://github.com/OpenSpace

**Are you an institutional user, science communicator, or researcher interested in OpenSpace?** We’d love to hear from you at our email: [{{< var email.support >}}]({{< var email.support >}})

**For the latest**: [Subscribe to our quarterly update or weekly events newsletter](https://mailchi.mp/365436fc7894/openspacenewsletter)
